posts.title: The Bada Gumbad
posts.description: A tomb that contains no body and what The Archaeological Survey calls a mausoleum but historians call it a gateway. No one agrees on what Bada Gumbad actually is.. but this surely has become a place for picnic and photoshoot for Delhi folks. connect with me on Bluesky
